dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Michael, do you feel it? I think we're being followed. Let's act normal and talk about du lịch. Where have you đến for du lịch?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Really? I don't notice anything strange... But if you say so... Well, I've du lịch to many places. I like Japan and Thailand the most. What about you, Mira? Where do you like to du lịch đến?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Don't look back! There's a người in black behind us. Keep talking about du lịch... I haven't du lịch as much as you. I've only đến Vietnam. But I want to đến Northern Europe, especially Finland. I heard there are many beautiful lakes and forests there.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: You're right, that người does look suspicious... Finland is an excellent choice! I've đến Helsinki once, the air is clean and nature is beautiful. If you like, maybe someday we could du lịch there together... I mean... if you want to...

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Du lịch with you? I... I don't know... But that người is still following us! What do you think they want?
